crew.overview: In a gritty and alternate 1985, the glory days of costumed vigilantes have been brought to a close by a government crackdown. But after one of the masked veterans is brutally murdered, an investigation into the killer is initiated. The reunited heroes set out to prevent their own destruction, but in doing so they uncover a sinister plot that puts all of humanity in grave danger.
crew.title: Watchmen

crew.overview: Powered with incredible speed, Sonic The Hedgehog embraces his new home on Earth. That is, until Sonic sparks the attention of super-uncool evil genius Dr. Robotnik. Now it’s super-villain vs. super-sonic in an all-out race across the globe to stop Robotnik from using Sonic’s unique power for world domination.
crew.title: Sonic the Hedgehog

details.biography: Sabine Varnes is a Canadian stuntwoman and actress. She enrolled in gymnastics at the age of 6 and shortly thereafter began competing. She won numerous local, regional and provincial honors over her ten year span. She graduated from Richmond High School in 1992 and then moved to Hawaii to further her gymnastics training and coaching skills. Sabine returned to Vancouver half a year later and moved to Whistler/Blackcomb mountain, where she enjoyed snowboarding and made lifelong friends. Continuing with her travels, she moved to Toronto, Canada and then Los Angeles, California to pursue a career as a stunt woman.
details.name: Sabine Varnes
